name: Kaneo work tracking skill
description: Runs the kaneo-work-tracking-skill installer (pinned to a commit): the kaneo-work-tracking skill, a managed CLAUDE.md block and the kaneo HTTP MCP server in .claude.json. inputs.name: KANEO_URL
